title: Stamp Duty Land Tax — changes to group relief
text:
This measure introduces a change of control test for the winding-up exception in the SDLT group relief rules when a company degroups.

 Group relief will be withdrawn and any additional SDLT charged if:

 • a company claims group relief

 • the winding-up exception later applies

 • control of the purchasing company changes within 3 years of the group-relieved transaction

 This measure applies to transactions with an effective date on or after 29 October 2026.
